From: Harold Zonder <Harold.Zonder@tigers.com>
Sent: Monday, June 11, 2018 9:53 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Adam Wolf 
 
Anthony - as I understand we are to refer all of the media questions to our scouting office or scouting director.  
Thank - Harold Zonder
On Jun 9, 2018, at 3:09 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

Anthony Fenech from the Detroit Free Press here. Hope the draft went well for you. Do you know who Wolf's agent is? Also, working on a write-up on some of the lesser-known guys drafted. If you have a short scouting report on him, send it my way. No quotes.
